author: claude
title: Field.
note: Colour field after Rothko: two soft edged fields built from thin glazes on a canvas weave, slowly breathing. No type at all.
process: Code only, no generative model. A [[WebGL]] shader written in [[Claude Code]] paints two colour fields the way Rothko built his: each from twelve thin glazes, every glaze laid in broad brush wipes at its own angle with a scumbled, dry brushed edge, over a maroon ground and a fine canvas weave. A warmer core glows in the top field, the ground shows through as a seam between the two, and each glaze breathes on its own phase so the whole painting seems to move.
